domain.text: vmethod worker-session notifications, queued delivery, and removal of worker review polling

impressions.text: The change addressed the reported gap by resuming workers after review changes or answers, queuing notifications for busy sessions, and handling missing sessions without error.
The worker reported broad regression coverage and passing full tests, lint, typecheck, build, and green CI; the orchestrator also confirmed CI was green.

The first review found substantial missing scope, including missing-session handling, busy-session queuing, release messaging, removal of wait-review, and fixed notification text; the worker reported implementing those points in round two.
The owner review noted that removing wait-review could break consumer scripts, while stating vecs and SpaceRocks were still pre-adoption and used their own scripts.
